claims: Dan Hurley is the head coach of the UConn men’s basketball team.
Dan Hurley has been leading the UConn Huskies since 2018.
Dan Hurley won consecutive NCAA championships in 2023 and 2024.
Dan Hurley was hired as head coach of UConn men's basketball on March 22, 2018.
Dan Hurley won the 2023 NCAA National Championship.
Dan Hurley won the 2024 NCAA National Championship.
Dan Hurley coached at the University of Rhode Island from 2012 to 2018.
Dan Hurley coached at Wagner College from 2010 to 2012.
Kimani Young is the associate head coach for UConn men's basketball in the 2025-26 season.
Luke Murray is an assistant coach for UConn men's basketball in the 2025-26 season.
Mike Nardi is an assistant coach for UConn men's basketball in the 2025-26 season.
Geno Auriemma is the head coach of the UConn women's basketball program
